description: This file defines platform-specific macros, includes, and utility functions for portability across different operating systems (Windows, Linux, macOS). It includes configuration for serial communication constants, compiler and platform-specific directives, and basic interface classes for reference counting and threading.

classes.name: IReferenceCounted
classes.description: Interface for reference counting objects with AddRef and Release methods.

classes.name: IUnknown
classes.description: Base interface extending IReferenceCounted with QueryInterface method for interface querying.

methods.name: SleepMs
methods.description: Sleep for a specified number of milliseconds.

methods.name: SleepUs
methods.description: Sleep for a specified number of microseconds.

methods.name: SleepS
methods.description: Sleep for a specified number of seconds.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Format a string with variable arguments into a string object.

methods.name: Demangled
methods.description: Get demangled class or function name from a mangled name.

methods.name: ClassName
methods.description: Extract class name from a mangled name.

methods.name: ClassNameOnly
methods.description: Extract only the class name from a mangled name.

methods.name: DumpCallStack
methods.description: Dump the call stack of a thread into a list of callstack_info.

methods.name: GetCallStack
methods.description: Retrieve call stack addresses for a thread.
